title: Silo Dark
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Silo Dark and the helm marks Night Vault. Do: Close on Night Vault. The Vault Clerk names which silo still has a case. An ambush holds the buoy until you enter 520 meters, and a raider wants the clerk. Finish: come inside Night Vault's shell. The Charter writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
